questions.nlq: Compute running totals of card-related expenses, grouped by event status and approval state, for all closed events with cumulative spending exceeding the original budget allocation.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH closed_event_budgets AS (
    SELECT 
        b.link_to_event,
        b.event_status,
        b.budget_id,
        SUM(b.amount) AS budget_allocation
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
    WHERE ev.status = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event, b.event_status, b.budget_id
),
expense_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        eb.event_status,
        e.approved,
        SUM(e.cost) AS cumulative_spending
    FROM expense e
    JOIN closed_event_budgets eb ON e.link_to_budget = eb.budget_id
    GROUP BY eb.event_status, e.approved
)
SELECT 
    ea.event_status,
    ea.approved,
    SUM(ea.cumulative_spending) AS running_total
FROM expense_aggregates ea
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        event_status,
        SUM(budget_allocation) AS total_budget
    FROM closed_event_budgets
    GROUP BY event_status
) bg ON ea.event_status = bg.event_status
GROUP BY ea.event_status, ea.approved
HAVING SUM(ea.cumulative_spending) > bg.total_budget

LEFT JOIN expense exp ON exp.link_to_member = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = exp.link_to_budget AND b.link_to_event = e.event_id

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH event_with_expenditure AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id, e.event_date
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    WHERE e.status = 'Closed' AND b.spent > 0
),
quarterly_attendance AS (
    SELECT 
        m.member_id,
        m.first_name,
        m.last_name,
        strftime('%Y', ea.event_date) || '-Q' || 
            CASE CAST(strftime('%m', ea.event_date) AS INTEGER)
                WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN 1
                WHEN 4 THEN 2 WHEN 5 THEN 2 WHEN 6 THEN 2
                WHEN 7 THEN 3 WHEN 8 THEN 3 WHEN 9 THEN 3
                WHEN 10 THEN 4 WHEN 11 THEN 4 WHEN 12 THEN 4
            END AS quarter,
        COUNT(*) AS attendance_count
    FROM member m
    JOIN attendance att ON m.member_id = att.link_to_member
    JOIN event_with_expenditure ea ON att.link_to_event = ea.event_id
    GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, quarter
),
ranked_members AS (
    SELECT 
        first_name,
        last_name,
        quarter,
        attendance_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY attendance_count DESC) AS ranking
    FROM quarterly_attendance
)
SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM ranked_members
ORDER BY quarter, ranking;
